# Security Hunter Ledger

One line per entry, newest last.

- 2026-11-18 | FIXED     | gateway-http | Validate calendar names in CalendarCreate/CalendarUpdate drafts: agent-authored `draft["calendar"]` reached `AgentSession.write_calendar_event/2` (`mkdir_p!` + write under `<agent_dir>/events/<calendar>`) and the raw CalDAV request line, so `../../../<victim>/self/...` planted files in another agent's tree and CR/LF injected headers (complements open #57, which covers calendar_query/calendar_delete only) | lib/tri_onyx/connectors/calendar.ex
- 2026-11-18 | DOWNGRADED| gateway-http | `href` from agent-written JSON (calendar_update draft, and cached event files read by calendar_delete) still goes unescaped into `caldav_request/5`'s request line — CR/LF request injection on the credentialed CalDAV connection; a guard rejecting whitespace/control chars in `path` in `caldav_request/5` would close it | lib/tri_onyx/connectors/calendar.ex
- 2026-11-18 | DOWNGRADED| gateway-http | CalDAV TLS uses `{:verify, :verify_none}` while sending Basic-auth credentials — network MITM steals CalDAV creds; fix needs CA store + an opt-out for self-signed servers (behaviour change) | lib/tri_onyx/connectors/calendar.ex
- 2026-11-18 | DOWNGRADED| gateway-http | BCP `{:bcp_response, query_id, _}` handler pops the pending query without checking `query.to == state.definition.name`, and query ids are the controller runtime's (agent-chosen) request_id, so a duplicate id overwrites another pending ETS entry; not exploitable without learning another query's uuid4 id | lib/tri_onyx/agent_session.ex, lib/tri_onyx/bcp/channel.ex
- 2026-11-18 | DOWNGRADED| gateway-http | `docker_socket: true` agents are attached to the compose network (`trionyx_default`) and can reach the unauthenticated gateway API on gateway:4000 (start/prompt agents, approve BCP/actions); needs gateway auth or a separate network — redesign | lib/tri_onyx/sandbox.ex
- 2026-11-18 | NO-FINDING| gateway-http | Also reviewed: `ExternalMessage` `:api_key` is never configured so `/messages` accepts any bearer (no marginal gain — whole :4000 API is unauthenticated by design); webhook IPv6-vs-IPv4 CIDR cross-family match in `cidr_match?/2` (moot while source IP is header-derived, see open #46); `/images` traversal (open #35/#61/#67/#74/#79/#80) | lib/tri_onyx/router.ex, lib/tri_onyx/webhook_receiver.ex
